title: AFP monitors 48 Chinese coast guard, naval vessels in West PH Sea
summary: The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) monitored a total of 48 Chinese coast guard and naval vessels in key features of the West Philippine Sea from September 8 to 14.
